links.comparator_used: LLM alone (AI acting alone, without physician involvement)
links.outcome: Diagnostic reasoning score (%) on expert-graded rubric
links.effect: LLM alone outperformed the trained physician plus LLM group by 11.5 percentage points (95% CI, 5.5 to 17.5; P < 0.001); in 38% of cases the physician plus LLM group surpassed the median LLM-alone performance
links.quote: While LLM alone outperformed the trained physician group by 11.5 percentage points (95% CI, 5.5 to 17.5; P < 0.001), in 38% of cases the physician plus LLM group surpassed the median LLM-alone performance, highlighting physician-AI complementarities.
